title: feat(fup): count bandwidth per instance-day from the source it was on (PL-5820)
body:
### Issue

PL-5820

### Description

FUP contract consumption now counts each instance-day from the source that instance was on that day, using the Fastly switch dates Farmer reports.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Bandwidth | whole period through one source, picked by the current fastlyEnabled flag | per day: Fastly days from Fastly egress, other days from NAT |
| Farmer unavailable | — | counted as zero |

Backend unit tests pass locally.

### Dependencies

- None
